videos.headline: Adam Schobel fires a TD pass to Ed Small for TCU
Kenny Johnson breaks the tackle for a Texas Tech TD
Mateen Ibirogba drops opposing QB for the sack
Thomas Castellanos finds J'Koby Williams for a Texas Tech TD
Malcolm Simmons returns the punt for a 79-yard TD for Texas Tech
Thomas Castellanos connects with Malcolm Simmons for a TD to add to Texas Tech's lead
Terrance Carter plows into the end zone for Red Raiders
Cameron Dickey rushes in for 16-yard TD
Adam Schobel throws 4-yard TD pass to Ed Small
